title: An infected cell displays a clue
hook: Predict the interaction and trace one immune step.

knows: The immune system includes cells and signaling molecules.
doesNotKnow: CD8 cytotoxic T cells can recognize peptides presented on MHC class I. Recognition and activation involve additional molecular interactions.

misconception: The immune response consists of one cell acting alone.
objective: Explain the stated interaction in a simplified immune response.

claims.text: Question, stage and reveal: A nucleated cell displays a peptide on MHC class I. Which T-cell group can recognize that peptide–MHC complex? CD8 cytotoxic T cells can recognize peptides presented on MHC class I. Recognition and activation involve additional molecular interactions.
Icons show one selected interaction rather than all required signals, and are not to scale.
Recall: Which T-cell group recognizes peptide presented on MHC class I? CD8 T cells can recognize peptide–MHC I complexes.

recall.question: Which T-cell group recognizes peptide presented on MHC class I?
recall.why: CD8 T cells can recognize peptide–MHC I complexes.
